issues.summary: unresolvedItems hardcoded to totalCount=0 / empty list reads as 'measured zero' rather than 'not measured'.
issues.fix: Replaced with a status discriminator: { status: 'not-measured', note: ... } with totalCount and bySourceAndReason omitted via JsonIgnore(WhenWritingNull).

issues.summary: ValidationRule + DefaultValue routed through SELECT-1-FROM-t-WHERE Jet SQL wrapper without a placeholder operand for Access criteria forms.
issues.fix: Added NormaliseCriteria helper that detects criteria-style values (leading Is/Like/In/Between/Not/operator) and prepends a synthetic 'x ' operand before SQL-wrapping.

issues.summary: Property-sheet scopes mismatched between the inventory tool (all *.yaml recursive) and the generator (Tables/Forms/Reports only); inventory counts did not reconcile with report counts.
issues.fix: Generator now walks the whole fixture mirror recursively with the same shared regex; both sides reconcile end-to-end.

issues.summary: Macro section reported actionsParsed / actionsUnresolved as if semantic enrichment ran, but only structurally counted Action= lines.
issues.fix: Renamed actionsParsed -> actionLines; dropped actionsUnresolved; spec and JSON shape updated to match.

issues.summary: UPDATE_PARSE_SUCCESS_REPORTS env var documented in spec but not wired; tests always overwrote committed golden.
issues.fix: AssertOrUpdate now honors UPDATE_PARSE_SUCCESS_REPORTS=1 (writes) vs default (asserts byte-equal with FindFirstDivergence error path).

issues.summary: Shared property-field regex used [^"]* which silently skipped YAML quoted scalars containing escaped inner quotes (`In (\"M\",\"F\",\"X\")`).
issues.fix: Updated both regexes to standard escaped-string body `(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*`. Net effect on counts: HHC ValidationRule 15->19, HHC DefaultValue 8->12, Northwind DefaultValue 15->16, Northwind Filter 8->12. Both regexes regenerate the same totals end-to-end.

issues.summary: Doc drift after the R1 fixes: residual references to pre-fix behavior (write-and-pass mode, empty-list unresolvedItems, aggregator wiring).
issues.fix: Updated Session 1 step 5 / step 6 / step 7 prose; updated Session 2 step 1 / Touches / progress-keys; updated determinism-rules text in spec; updated generator file header.

issues.summary: Residual doc drift after R2 fix: three named spots (generator file-header 'empty list' phrasing, spec determinism rules 'render as null', spec Session 1 step 5 'aggregator wiring').
issues.fix: Updated all three spots inline; comments and spec text now consistently describe the live `unresolvedItems.status = 'not-measured'` contract with omission-not-null semantics.
